owner: Parent may transfer these into orchestration records; those records were not edited

decisions.decision: Measure the weaker physical surface direction on every rendered triangle at every LOD
decisions.reason: Area density can hide a collapsed or stretched UV direction
decisions.boundary: Actual image resolution and decoded world-space geometry; area <= 1e-14 square metres is disclosed separately, never counted as sampled visible area.

decisions.decision: Use shared periodic growth microtextures and local semantic material factors
decisions.reason: Class-resolution maps must support 256/512 px per metre without repeating a large painted repair motif
decisions.boundary: Macro repair geometry and face assignments carry wear. No runtime shader workaround, map-size increase or threshold relaxation.

decisions.decision: Use modern RGBA MIX multiply nodes for constant tint
decisions.reason: Blender 5.2 glTF export discarded legacy MixRGB factors despite passing stock validation
decisions.boundary: Exact actual-export tint, emission, normal scale, direct ORM factors and UV routes are checked.

decisions.decision: Retain the original saved polygon and normal data
decisions.reason: An intermediate triangulation preserved rendered geometry but changed some corner normals
decisions.boundary: Original LFS source objects were hash/size verified before reading; geometry was not regenerated or copied from another city.

decisions.decision: Add measured codec margin only to polygons matched to undersampled decoded triangles
decisions.reason: Position quantization changed tiny triangle metrics enough to miss the target despite passing source density
decisions.boundary: No unused-face padding. UV changes affect the identified visible faces; final compressed density must pass independently.

decisions.decision: Reject unsupported source modifier/UV routes and incomplete export coverage
decisions.reason: The focused implementation-tool review found possible false-PASS cases
decisions.boundary: Tool review is not the parent independent source-art review or native visual acceptance.
